heading: SEBI's New ETF Pricing Rules: What Investors Need to Know
tldr: SEBI has introduced new rules for Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) that will come into effect from September 7, 2026.
The changes primarily impact how ETF base prices and daily price bands are determined, aiming to improve price discovery and reduce volatility.
Pre-open auction mechanisms for ETFs will be modified to ensure more robust and fair opening prices.
New close-out procedures for failed ETF trades are being implemented, enhancing investor protection and market integrity.
Investors should understand these updates to adapt their trading strategies and benefit from potentially more efficient ETF markets.
caption:
Ever wondered how ETF prices are set? Good news! SEBI is changing the rules to make ETF trading fairer and smoother for everyone. These updates, coming in 2026, mean less surprise volatility and better protection for your investments. It's all about making sure you get the best possible price when you buy or sell.
